test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a triangle ABC, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Side AB + Side BC > Side AC
Side AB + Side BC = Side AC
Side AB + Side BC ≥ Side AC

solution:
**Concept used:**

Properties of a triangle : The sum of the length of two sides of a triangle 

is always greater than the length of the third side of a triangle 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have given a triangle ABC 

So, its sides are AB,BC and AC 

So, according to the property of a triangle sum of the length of its two sides should always 

be greater than the length of the third side 

⇒ Side AB + Side BC > Side AC always holds true 

Which is given in only option(1). So, all other options are incorrect 

**Hence, Side AB +Side BC > Side AC .**
